title: Family members of political prisoners protest outside the US Embassy in Baku
location: Outside the US Embassy, Baku, Azerbaijan
scope: One local Baku action is reported; wider coordination is not established.
organizer: Family members of people described as political prisoners; no formal organizing body is identified in the opened report.
participants_original: Family members took part; the opened report gives no crowd estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: The opened account reports no attendance number or qualitative estimate that establishes 50 participants. Eligibility remains pending threshold evidence.

title.summary: The opened VOA report describes family members of people it calls political prisoners holding an action outside the US Embassy.

start_date.summary: The opened report is dated 9 February 2021 and describes the action as occurring that day.

end_date.summary: No physical end time or end date is reported.

location.summary: The report places the action outside the US Embassy in Baku.

scope.summary: One local action is described; no multi-site coordination is reported.

organizer.summary: Participants are identified as family members; a formal organizer is not named.

demands.summary: The banner seeks release or acquittal of political prisoners and the report describes objections to their trials. A family representative says Azerbaijani state offices had already been approached; requests for foreign observers are supplementary.

participants.summary: The report identifies family participants but states no number.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The opened account contains no numeric or qualitative turnout estimate supporting 50 or more.

protester_violence.summary: No participant violence is described; silence is not treated as evidence of absence.

state_response.summary: Police reportedly took and tore signs/photos. The report does not establish whether the crowd was dispersed or document the remaining response dimensions; all seven remain unknown. The US Embassy's separate statement is not Azerbaijani state accommodation.

notes: The US Embassy is the venue, not the sole demand recipient: the family representative says Azerbaijani state offices had already been approached, and the banner seeks release/acquittal in domestic cases. The request that foreign organizations or embassies observe proceedings is additional. Keep separate from the 19 February action involving about ten female relatives in S005; no shared organizer or continuous action is established. NEWS.am S001 and Eurasianet S025 are unverified search-only leads and are not corroboration. Do not carry the January burial grievance or Drmbon roadblock into this event.
open_questions: Find a reliable attendance count or qualitative estimate for this February 9 action.
Establish the physical end and whether police taking signs coincided with crowd dispersal.
Identify whether NEWS.am S001 or Eurasianet S025 describes this same action; both remain search-only.
Compare against the official baseline and human review before any final inclusion decision.
